metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI project under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with the `ical` binary entry point in [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It supports:

- `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

The code is split across [date.rs](/workspace/output/src/date.rs), [parser.rs](/workspace/output/src/parser.rs), [expand.rs](/workspace/output/src/expand.rs), [model.rs](/workspace/output/src/model.rs), and [json.rs](/workspace/output/src/json.rs). `Cargo.toml` keeps `[dependencies]` empty.

I verified it builds with `cargo build --release`. The implementation covers component parsing, raw property preservation, RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE handling, VEVENT override expansion including `RECURRENCE-ID` and `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`, and VTIMEZONE-based UTC resolution. One deliberate gap remains: non-Gregorian `RSCALE` is parsed and surfaced, but expansion emits `rscale_unsupported` instead of implementing alternate calendar arithmetic.
